title: GREAT Geometry-Intention Collaborative Inference for Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Affordance Grounding
one_line: 几何-意图协同推理框架实现开放词汇3D物体功能定位
innovations: 多头功能思维链推理策略(MHACoT)
跨模态自适应融合模块(CMAFM)

experiment_framework: PIADv2数据集 Seen/Unseen Object/Unseen Affordance三划分，AUC/aIOU/SIM/MAE指标，与IAG/LASO等基线对比

weaknesses: MLLM微调可能引入额外计算开销
